## Goal
- Fix HTTP 409 Conflict in IVX Senior Developer job queue by implementing per-owner single-flight execution, granular stage tracking, stale job expiration, cancel/resume endpoints, and queue-attached response for duplicate requests.

## Constraints & Preferences
- **Expo/React Native is the ACTIVE production app** — Kotlin `android-ivx-holdings/` is abandoned per owner instruction
- Use `bun` not `npx`/`npm` in this environment
- No fabricated proof — every VERIFIED claim must have real evidence
- No business data modification during QA
- Canonical push path is `expo/sync-github.mjs` using Git Data API; Rork git proxy does NOT forward to GitHub
- Never discard the user's request — always queue or attach to active job
- Only one active Senior Developer task per owner at a time
- Stale job timeout configurable via `IVX_WORKER_STALE_TIMEOUT_MS` env var (default 30 min)

## Progress
### Done
- **Investment Card Upgrade — FULLY COMPLETED & VERIFIED** — 19/19 tests pass, 0 TS errors, 0 lint errors, final report produced with VERIFIED status
- **APK BUILD #7 COMPLETED** — `expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk` — 79MB, all 4 CPU architectures, 242 screens, served via Cloudflare tunnel
- **HTTP 409 FIX — code written across 6 files:**
  - REWROTE `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` — Added `IVXWorkerJobStage` (QUEUED/RUNNING/PATCHING/TESTING/COMMITTING/DEPLOYING/VERIFYING/COMPLETED/FAILED), `enqueueOrAttachSeniorDeveloperJob()` with per-owner single-flight, `getActiveJobForOwner()`, `cancelSeniorDeveloperJob()`, `resumeSeniorDeveloperJob()`, `expireStaleJobs()` with periodic sweep, `updateJobStage()` with progress %, `phaseToStage()` mapper, `STALE_JOB_TIMEOUT_MS` configurable, `startStaleJobSweep()`, `activeJobControllers` Map for cancel signaling, backwards-compatible `enqueueSeniorDeveloperJob()` delegating to new API
  - UPDATED `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts` — Added `onPhase?: (phase, detail) => void` to `IVXSeniorDeveloperRunInput`, invoked at 10 phases: queued, repo_brain_indexed, plan_created, diff_proposed, patch_approval_checked, patch_applied, validation_started, validation_completed, git_deploy_operator_checked, production_verified
  - UPDATED `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` — Added `handleSeniorDeveloperWorkerActiveJobRequest`, `handleSeniorDeveloperWorkerCancelJobRequest`, `handleSeniorDeveloperWorkerResumeJobRequest`, modified enqueue to use `enqueueOrAttachSeniorDeveloperJob` returning 409+jobId when attached, 202 when new
  - UPDATED `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts` — Routed `/run` through worker queue instead of synchronous `runIVXSeniorDeveloperTask`, added `getActiveJobForOwner` check before enqueue, returns 409 with jobId+activeJob+cancel URL when active job exists, returns 202 with jobId+stage+progress when enqueued
  - UPDATED `backend/hono.ts` — Added imports for 3 new handlers, registered routes: `GET /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/active`, `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs/:jobId/cancel`, `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs/:jobId/resume`
  - REWROTE `backend/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts` — Tests for per-owner single-flight, attach behavior, different owners, cancel, resume, stale expiration, worker status capabilities, backwards-compatible enqueue
- **Investment card files completed (from prior task):** `expo/lib/timeline-stages.ts`, `expo/components/InvestmentCard.tsx`, `expo/components/InvestorFirstFeed.tsx`, `expo/app/jv-invest.tsx`, `expo/lib/published-deal-card-model.ts`, `expo/__tests__/investment-card-timeline.test.ts`
- **Watchman bypass working** — fake watchman at `/tmp/fakebin/watchman` + `metro.config.js` patched
- **boto3 installed** via pip3; `expo/scripts/upload-apk.mjs` created

### In Progress
- **HTTP 409 FIX — validation phase** — code written but lint, typecheck, tests, and build have NOT been run yet for the 409 fix changes

### Blocked
- **AWS credentials NOT in environment** — cannot upload to S3 (`ivxholding.com` bucket) permanently

## Key Decisions
- Per-owner single-flight: duplicate requests ATTACH to running job (return its jobId + HTTP 409) instead of discarding or creating overlapping jobs
- `/run` endpoint now routes through worker queue (returns 202 + jobId) instead of synchronous execution (which returned 200/409 with full proof)
- Stale jobs auto-expire after configurable timeout (default 30 min) via periodic sweep every 60s
- Cancel signals via `activeJobControllers` Map — controller's `cancelled` flag checked before, during, and after execution
- Granular stages mapped from runtime phases via `phaseToStage()` with progress percentages (QUEUED:0, RUNNING:10, PATCHING:25, TESTING:50, COMMITTING:65, DEPLOYING:80, VERIFYING:90, COMPLETED:100)
- Backwards-compatible `enqueueSeniorDeveloperJob()` preserved, delegates to `enqueueOrAttachSeniorDeveloperJob()`
- Investment card: kept new compact design, added summary panel + timeline + developer row (COMPLETED)

## Next Steps
- Run `bun test backend/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts` to validate new queue tests
- Run `bunx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck` on backend to check for TypeScript errors
- Run `bun run lint` on backend to check for lint errors
- Fix any compilation or test failures
- Verify all 10 acceptance criteria are met
- Produce final report with VERIFIED/BLOCKED/FAILED status

## Critical Context

- `runIVXSeniorDeveloperTask()` at line 1596 of `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts`
- Worker queue persists via `ivx-durable-store` (Supabase-backed) or in-memory fallback
- Proof ledger persists to GitHub side-branch `ivx-proof-ledger` when no Supabase service key
- Existing routes: `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/run`, `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs`, `GET /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs/:jobId`
- New routes: `GET /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/active`, `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs/:jobId/cancel`, `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs/:jobId/resume`
- Backend URL: `https://api.ivxholding.com` (healthy)
- Landing URL: `https://ivxholding.com`
- APK: v1.4.5, versionCode 36, `com.ivxholdings.app`, served at `https://designated-mississippi-devel-screen.trycloudflare.com/ivx-holdings-v1.4.5.apk`
- JAVA_HOME: `/usr/lib/jvm/jdk-17.0.13+11`
